set.body: Make remote access an explicit portable layer rather than a Browser-only special case. Move the Future-based array and hierarchy reader into shared code as AsyncZarr while retaining source-compatible BrowserZarr facades on Scala.js. Add an explicit immutable CacheNamespace or store-revision identity and bounded in-memory ObjectReader and AsyncObjectReader cache decorators: exact whole/range/length reuse, containing-range slicing where lawful, deterministic LRU eviction by byte and entry budgets, defensive byte ownership, quantitative hit/miss/fetched/served/evicted receipts, and asynchronous single-flight collapse for identical in-flight requests. Cache failures never persist and no cache can be constructed without a caller-supplied namespace, preventing silent reuse across mutable dataset revisions. Keep ReadLimits.maxConcurrentRequests as the only reader scheduling knob and prove its bound on JVM and Scala.js; provide an explicitly named blocking sync-to-async adapter for JVM callers with a dedicated ExecutionContext. Gates: shared sync/async cache law tests, revision isolation, resource and overflow limits, concurrent single-flight and failure retry, region/factored/sharded re-read without downstream requests, JVM HTTP and Scala.js Fetch parity, portable AsyncZarr re-open on both platforms, Zarr-Python and at least one independent implementation/conformance corpus where workable, standalone artifact compilation, and an fMRI-shaped remote trace showing request and byte reductions. No global cache, persistence, TTL policy, retries, credentials, S3 SDK, service worker, or NeuroArchive retention policy in this slice.
set.title: Zarr Z8.5: revision-scoped remote cache and portable async reads
